show monday
scene sky
Niki’s first night back was pretty peaceful, all things considered.
lines.zh: 总的来说，Niki 回来的第一晚还算平静。

lines.en: At least if you can ignore the part where I was made to sleep on the floor while she got the bed.
lines.zh: 只要你忽略掉我被打发睡地板、她独占床那部分的话。

lines.en: That’s just one of many compromises that will have to be made if things are going to get better, though. And I’m more than willing to make many more so long as it keeps her by my side.
lines.zh: 不过，如果事情要往好的方向走，这只是必须做出的众多妥协之一。而只要能让她留在我身边，再多的妥协我也心甘情愿。

lines.en: {size=-2}I’m out and about now, trying to reintroduce myself to society as a slightly less depressed man with a slightly angrier daughter who will need to suffer slightly more if she ever wants to become slightly human.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}我现在正出门在外，试着以一个稍微没那么抑郁的男人的身份重新融入社会——身边还跟着一个稍微更愤怒一点的女儿，而她要是想稍微变得像个人样，还得再多吃点苦头。{/size}

lines.en: And while this makes things inarguably more dangerous for all of us, it’s something I’m making a bet on because drastic times call for drastic measures.
lines.zh: 虽然这毫无疑问让我们所有人变得更危险，但我还是把赌注押了上去，因为非常时期得用非常手段。

lines.en: So she can try to prop up the status quo against the cage I’ve been trapped in all she likes. The fact of the matter is I’ve begun the process of melting it down to reshape it.
lines.zh: 她尽可以想怎么支撑那套把我困住的现状就怎么支撑。事实是，我已经开始把它熔化、重塑。

lines.en: And if that reforms the world as we know it, good. In fact, if it changes anything at all, {i}good.{/i} Witness this effort of mine, for it will be the first and last you ever see.
lines.zh: 如果这能改造我们所知的世界，那很好。事实上，只要它能改变点什么，那就{i}很好{/i}。见证我的这番努力吧，因为这将是你们第一次也是最后一次见到。

lines.en: And take note of all that rides in with it, for these will be the impurities that carry me from here to Heaven.
lines.zh: 也请留意随之而来的一切，因为正是这些杂质，会把我从这里带往天堂。

lines.en: Assuming, of course, that I am not assassinated by some sort of angry fan before any of that happens since Niki decided to turn me into the most hated man in Kumon-mi in just twenty-four hours.
lines.zh: 当然，前提是在那之前我没被某个愤怒的粉丝暗杀——毕竟 Niki 只用二十四小时就把我变成了 Kumon-mi 最招人恨的男人。

lines.en: I’ve got to hand it to her, though. I am finally getting the disdain I deserve. So for that and so much more, I thank her.
lines.zh: 不过我得服她。我总算得到了我应得的鄙视。就凭这一点，还有多得多的其他事，我得谢谢她。

lines.en: I reserve the right to stay mildly angry about the rest of the consequences, though. So please excuse me while I deal with more of them now.
lines.zh: 不过对于其余的后果，我保留适度生气的权利。所以接下来我得去处理更多后果，请见谅。

lines.en: : Hello?
lines.zh: 喂？

lines.en: : {i}Papa! What have you done?!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}爸爸！你都干了些什么？！{/i}

lines.en: : Overall or just this morning?
lines.zh: 总的来说，还是只说今天早上？

lines.en: : {i}Overall! Big sis Chika is broken again and Chinami doesn’t know how to fix her this time!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总的来说！Chika 姐姐又坏掉了，这次 Chinami 不知道该怎么修好她！{/i}

lines.en: : Chinami never knows how to fix her because Chika is unfixable. But yes, I guess it makes sense that she’d be...{i}off{/i} given recent developments.
lines.zh: Chinami 从来都不知道该怎么修，因为 Chika 根本修不好。不过是啊，考虑到最近的事态，她会有点……{i}不对劲{/i}也说得通。

lines.en: : {i}What developments?! Chinami still doesn’t know what happened!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}什么最近的事态？！Chinami 还完全不知道发生了什么！{/i}

lines.en: : Have you not been using your phone? I’m apparently the talk of the town right now.
lines.zh: 你没看手机吗？我现在好像是全城的谈资了。

lines.en: : {i}If Chinami finds out that Papa is in one of those videos Tsukasa has been watching lately, she’s going to be very disappointed!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}要是 Chinami 发现爸爸出现在 Tsukasa 最近看的那种视频里，她会非常失望的！{/i}

lines.en: : Tell you what — are you guys both at home right now? I can come over and face Chika directly. It’s probably easier than handling all of this over the phone.
lines.zh: 这样吧——你们俩现在都在家吗？我可以过去跟 Chika 当面谈。大概比在电话里扯这些要容易。

lines.en: : {i}Papa can try, but big sis Chika hasn’t said a word since yesterday. And also, she has a knife.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}爸爸可以试试，不过 Chika 姐姐从昨天起就一句话都没说过。而且，她手里拿着刀。{/i}

lines.en: : Please lock yourself in the bathroom until I get there.
lines.zh: 在我到之前，请你把自己锁在浴室里。

lines.en: : {i}Okay. But please bring Chinami food since big sis Chika normally makes breakfast for her and can’t this time because Papa is apparently famous now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}好吧。不过请给 Chinami 带点吃的，因为平时都是 Chika 姐姐给她做早饭，这次做不了了，因为爸爸现在好像出名了。{/i}

lines.en: : I’ll take you both out to eat once your sister is functional again. Okay?
lines.zh: 等你姐姐恢复正常，我就带你们俩出去吃。行吗？

lines.en: : {i}Okay! Bring a weapon too. Chinami thinks you might need one. Bye!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}好！也带件武器来。Chinami 觉得你可能会用得上。再见！{/i}

lines.en: scene black
I try not to take too much of the blame on the way to Chika’s place. I mean, it’s not like I haven’t tried to tell her about this before.
lines.zh: 在去 Chika 家的路上，我尽量不把太多责任揽到自己身上。我是说，我又不是没试着跟她讲过这些。

lines.en: And yes, I imagine most of that is the fruit of some sort of self-preservational tic. But this is one she was born with rather than an injury received during her fall from grace.
lines.zh: 没错，我想这多半是某种自我保护本能结出的果。不过这是她与生俱来的东西，而不是她堕落时受的伤。

lines.en: Will my words be enough to mend her broken bones, though? Is there a song I can play from speakers meant to soothe instead of ones there to distract her while I steal her heart once more?
lines.zh: 可我的话够不够把她的断骨接好呢？有没有一首歌，能从真正用来安抚的音箱里放出来，而不是那种只是为了分散她注意力、好让我再一次偷走她的心的音箱？

lines.en: Find out soon in “My Adventures as a Trash Compactor,” my newly named autobiography, where I tell the uncensored story of how I turn what’s already broken into something even smaller.
lines.zh: 敬请期待我新命名的自传《我作为垃圾压缩机的冒险》，在里面我会毫无保留地讲述，我是如何把已经坏掉的东西压得更小的。

lines.en: Something {i}no one{/i} would want but me.
lines.zh: 一个{i}除了我之外没人{/i}会想要的东西。

lines.en: For it’s this exact secret that allows me to live at all in the first place.
lines.zh: 因为正是这个秘密，才让我一开始还能活着。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes1
: Thank goodness Papa is finally here! Chinami doesn’t know what else she can do!
lines.zh: 谢天谢地爸爸终于来了！Chinami 不知道自己还能怎么办了！

lines.en: : You look familiar for some reason.
lines.zh: 你看着有点眼熟。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes2
: Oh! Chinami bleached her hair again and she forgot that Papa hasn’t seen it yet. Maybe Chinami just reminds you of Chinami?
lines.zh: 哦！Chinami 又把头发漂了一遍，忘了爸爸还没见过。也许是 Chinami 让你想起了 Chinami 自己？

lines.en: : No...I don’t think that’s it. But I also don’t think I want to know what it is, so just go ahead and brief me on the situation.
lines.zh: 不……我觉得不是这个。不过我也不觉得我想知道是什么，所以你直接跟我说说情况吧。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes3
: The situation is this way! And it’s not going anywhere any time soon, so Chinami will accompany you ten feet from the doorway so you can see it yourself!
lines.zh: 情况在这边！而且它一时半会儿也不会挪窝，所以 Chinami 就陪你走到离门口十英尺的地方，你自己看吧！

lines.en: : And hopefully fix it because Chinami is hungry and fearful she may never eat again!
lines.zh: 而且希望能把它修好，因为 Chinami 饿了，还害怕自己再也吃不上饭了！

lines.en: : You know how to make your own breakfast, Chinami. You don’t need Chika for that.
lines.zh: 你会自己做早饭的啊，Chinami。这事你用不着 Chika。

lines.en: : Chinami would sooner starve than do things on her own! Come, Papa! We have to fix my sister!
lines.zh: Chinami 宁可饿死也不愿意自己动手！来吧，爸爸！我们得把我姐姐修好！

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes4
: Okay, journey over. We’re here.
lines.zh: 好了，路程结束。我们到了。

lines.en: : Thank you for escorting me a total of three steps. I never would have made it here on my own.
lines.zh: 谢谢你护送我整整三步路。我自己是绝对走不到这儿的。

lines.en: : You can thank Chinami by getting to the bottom of this.
lines.zh: 你要谢 Chinami，就把这件事查个水落石出。

lines.en: : I already know what the cause is. Her idol decided to tell the entire world that we were in love yesterday and I imagine it just broke Chika’s brain.
lines.zh: 我已经知道原因了。她的偶像昨天决定告诉全世界我们恋爱了，我猜 Chika 的脑子就这么烧掉了。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes5
: That doesn’t make any sense. Why would Niki tell the world she’s in love with you?
lines.zh: 这说不通啊。Niki 为什么要告诉全世界她爱上了你？

lines.en: : Probably because she is.
lines.zh: 大概因为她确实是。

lines.en: : Why, though? She can do so much better.
lines.zh: 可为什么呢？她明明能找到好得多的。

lines.en: : So can your sister and that’s never stopped her from being obsessed with me.
lines.zh: 你姐姐也一样，可这从来不妨碍她对我痴迷。

lines.en: : Good point, Papa. Chinami has a lot of questions but, right now, she cares most about teaching her big sister how to talk again. And nothing she’s tried has worked.
lines.zh: 说得有道理，爸爸。Chinami 有很多问题，不过眼下她最关心的是怎么让她姐姐重新开口说话。而她试过的办法都没用。

lines.en: : Well, what have you tried?
lines.zh: 那么，你都试过什么？

lines.en: : A bunch of stuff. But not even getting a bunch of peanuts delivered here and threatening to eat them in front of her could make her blink.
lines.zh: 试了一堆东西。可就算叫了一大堆花生送到这里、威胁说要在她面前吃下去，也没能让她眨一下眼。

lines.en: : Chinami had to drag her all the way over to the chair just so she wouldn’t be standing all night. She’s at her wit’s end here!
lines.zh: Chinami 还得把她一路拖到椅子上，好让她不至于站一整晚。她已经束手无策了！

lines.en: : And it turned out that all the peanuts did was lead to temptation and now {i}Chinami{/i} is suffering too!
lines.zh: 结果那些花生唯一的作用就是制造诱惑，现在连{i}Chinami{/i}自己也遭罪了！

lines.en: : I’m actually impressed you aren’t dead yet.
lines.zh: 你还活着，说实话我挺佩服的。

lines.en: : Me too, but for other sadder reasons than just peanuts. Do you think you can fix her?
lines.zh: 我也是，不过原因比花生更让人难过。你觉得你能修好她吗？

lines.en: : Only one way to find out.
lines.zh: 只有试了才知道。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes6
: Chika, I hereby exercise my power as your idol’s significant other to grant you exclusive behind-the-scenes access to Niki for whatever her next public event is.
lines.zh: Chika，我现在以你偶像另一半的身份行使我的权力，授予你 Niki 下一场公开活动的独家后台通行证。

lines.en: : Assuming she actually has another and that she isn’t being sued for breach of contract.
lines.zh: 前提是她真的还有下一场，而且没因为违约被起诉。

lines.en: : Fine. I also grant you exclusive behind-the-scenes access to Niki in her natural habitat — watching anime in my bedroom with a bag of potato chips in her lap.
lines.zh: 好吧。我再授予你 Niki 在自然栖息地的独家后台参观权——在我卧室里腿上放着一袋薯片看动画。

lines.en: : And I cannot overstate just how much of a risk I am taking by telling you this as the sheer idea of such a thing would ruin her image, so I’m told.
lines.zh: 而且我怎么强调都不为过：告诉你这件事我冒了多大的风险，因为据说光是这种事的念头就足以毁掉她的形象。

lines.en: : Do you think it’s working?
lines.zh: 你觉得有用吗？

lines.en: : Chika, if you don’t say anything in the next ten seconds, I’m going to run away with your little sister and marry her.
lines.zh: Chika，要是你十秒之内还不说话，我就要带你妹妹私奔，然后娶了她。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes7
: Chinami never consented to this! She doesn’t even know if she likes boys yet!
lines.zh: Chinami 可没同意！她连自己喜不喜欢男孩子都还不知道呢！

lines.en: : I don’t think it matters.
lines.zh: 我觉得这不重要。

lines.en: : Of course it matters! Chinami doesn’t wanna marry somebody she doesn’t love! Especially not after being kidnapped!
lines.zh: 当然重要！Chinami 才不要嫁给一个自己不爱的人！尤其是在被绑架之后！

lines.en: : No, I mean it isn’t working. Chika’s catatonia has seemingly overwritten both her moral obligations and her most intense desires. I’m not sure I can help.
lines.zh: 不，我的意思是没用。Chika 的木僵状态似乎已经覆盖了她的道德义务和最强烈的欲望。我不确定我帮得上忙。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes8
: What do you mean you can’t help?! Are you saying that big sis Chika is stuck like this forever?! Chinami’s not supposed to be the caregiver in this relationship! {i}She{/i} is!
lines.zh: 什么叫你帮不上忙？！你是说 Chika 姐姐要永远这样了？！这段关系里该照顾人的不该是 Chinami！{i}她{/i}才是！

lines.en: : At the very least, we should try and get that knife out of her hands. This isn’t exactly the type of situation sharp objects help with, I don’t think.
lines.zh: 至少，我们该想办法把她手里的刀拿走。我觉得这种情况下，利器可帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : Chinami tried already, but big sis Chika just held it up higher and Chinami couldn’t reach it.
lines.zh: Chinami 已经试过了，可 Chika 姐姐只是把刀举得更高，Chinami 够不着。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, that’s good at least. It seems she’s still {i}subconsciously{/i} trying to protect you.
lines.zh: 好吧。至少这是好事。看来她{i}下意识{/i}里还在试图保护你。

lines.en: : And if the Chika we know is buried somewhere inside of the Chika shell we have here, we just need to figure out how to...unearth her.
lines.zh: 如果我们认识的那个 Chika 被埋在眼前这具 Chika 躯壳里的某个地方，我们只需要想办法……把她挖出来。

lines.en: : Unearth her? But how are we gonna do that?
lines.zh: 把她挖出来？可我们要怎么做？

lines.en: : I do have one idea. It just requires a level of...{i}participation{/i} I’m not sure I’m going to get.
lines.zh: 我倒是有个主意。只是它需要某种程度的……{i}配合{/i}，我不确定我能不能得到。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes9
: Participation?...
lines.zh: 配合？……

lines.en: : Surely Papa doesn’t intend to make love to big sis Chika in her current state?!
lines.zh: 爸爸总不至于想在 Chika 姐姐现在这个状态下跟她做爱吧？！

lines.en: : What? Where did...no. What?
lines.zh: 什么？这从哪……不。什么？

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes10
: Okay...If Papa thinks that’s the only way to make her go back to normal, Chinami has no choice but to support it. She grants you consent on behalf of her big sister.
lines.zh: 好吧……如果爸爸觉得这是唯一能让她恢复正常的办法，那 Chinami 别无选择，只能支持。她代表姐姐同意了。

lines.en: : I literally just said no.
lines.zh: 我刚才真的已经说了不行。

lines.en: : All she asks is that you be gentle with her to avoid breaking her more. Because she’s heard you guys together before and thinks you might be a little too rough sometimes.
lines.zh: 她只求你对她温柔点，别把她弄得更坏。因为她以前听过你们俩在一起的声音，觉得你有时候可能有点太粗暴了。

lines.en: : Chinami, are you even listening to me?
lines.zh: Chinami，你到底有没有在听我说话？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: : But you just responded...
lines.zh: 可你刚刚明明回答了……

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes11
: Because I think it might be a good idea now! And it’s Papa’s fault for making me think that by saying “participation” so weirdly! What else was that supposed to mean in that context?!
lines.zh: 因为我现在觉得这也许是个好主意！而且都怪爸爸把「配合」说得那么奇怪，害我这么想！在那种语境下它还能是什么意思？！

lines.en: : Certainly not taking advantage of a girl who’s basically in a vegetative state right now.
lines.zh: 反正肯定不是乘人之危去占一个现在基本处于植物状态的女孩的便宜。

lines.en: : Not even if it’s the only way to save her?!
lines.zh: 就算这是唯一能救她的办法也不行？！

lines.en: : She’s holding a knife.
lines.zh: 她手里拿着刀。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes12
: So what?! Maybe Papa likes living on the edge and doesn’t have a problem with that?!
lines.zh: 那又怎样？！说不定爸爸就喜欢在刀尖上过日子，一点都不介意呢？！

lines.en: : Chinami, by “participation” I meant calling someone {i}else{/i} to come and help.
lines.zh: Chinami，我说的「配合」是指叫{i}别的{/i}人来帮忙。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes13
: But who else besides Papa would be able to fix big sis Chika right now? Big sis Yumi maybe? To try and beat her up?
lines.zh: 可除了爸爸，还有谁能现在修好 Chika 姐姐？Yumi 姐姐吗？来把她打一顿？

lines.en: : Why are all of your ideas so physical all of a sudden?
lines.zh: 你的主意怎么突然都这么暴力？

lines.en: : Chinami was desperate for food and ate a bunch of sugar packets before Papa came here. She thinks that may have made her crazy.
lines.zh: Chinami 饿坏了，在爸爸来之前吃了一大堆糖包。她觉得那可能让她发疯了。

lines.en: : You just wanted to eat sugar packets, didn’t you?
lines.zh: 你就是想吃糖包而已吧？

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes14
: I’ll do anything to save my sister. I don’t care how much sugar I need to eat to do it.
lines.zh: 为了救姐姐，我什么都愿意做。要吃多少糖都无所谓。

lines.en: : That’s great, Chinami. But what {i}I{/i} was thinking was getting Niki to come here to see if {i}she{/i} can help.
lines.zh: 很好，Chinami。不过{i}我{/i}想的是叫 Niki 过来，看看{i}她{/i}能不能帮上忙。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes15
: You can’t invite {i}her{/i} here! Chinami doesn’t have anything to wear! She can’t meet a celebrity looking like {i}this!{/i}
lines.zh: 不能把{i}她{/i}请到这儿来！Chinami 没有能穿的衣服！她不能{i}这副样子{/i}去见一个大明星！

lines.en: : You look really cute, though.
lines.zh: 可你看起来很可爱啊。

lines.en: : Maybe to you! But not to a world famous idol that Chinami has posters of! Why do you even know her anyway?!
lines.zh: 也就是你觉得！对一个 Chinami 还贴着她海报的世界级偶像来说可不算！话说你到底为什么会认识她啊？！

lines.en: : We were childhood friends, Chinami. Her little sister is literally Chika’s classmate.
lines.zh: 我们是青梅竹马，Chinami。她妹妹正好就是 Chika 的同学。

lines.en: : Why were you childhood friends with somebody so much younger than you?! Has Papa {i}always{/i} been a lolicon?!
lines.zh: 你为什么会跟一个比你小那么多的家伙是青梅竹马？！爸爸{i}一直{/i}都是萝莉控吗？！

lines.en: : She’s only two years younger than me...
lines.zh: 她只比我小两岁而已……

lines.en: : Lies! Chinami will believe it once the celebrity is in her house! She just needs to find something to wear first!
lines.zh: 骗人！等那个明星进了她家门，Chinami 才会相信！她得先找件衣服穿！

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes16
: Are you really sure you don’t want to try the other idea first, though? Maybe Papa can shock big sis Chika back to life with his-
lines.zh: 不过你真的确定不想先试试另一个主意吗？说不定爸爸能用他的——把 Chika 姐姐电醒——

lines.en: : Yeah, no. Stay here. I’m going to make a call.
lines.zh: 不，别。留在这儿。我去打个电话。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes17
: What do you mean “stay here?!” Where else do you expect Chinami to go?!
lines.zh: 「留在这儿」是什么意思？！你还指望 Chinami 去哪儿？！

lines.en: : I have no idea. Go eat some more sugar packets or something.
lines.zh: 我怎么知道。再去吃点糖包什么的。

lines.en: : Fine! But only because Chinami is feeling particularly obedient all of a sudden!
lines.zh: 好吧！只不过是因为 Chinami 突然变得特别听话！

lines.en: : Wow, I wonder why.
lines.zh: 哇，我想知道是为什么呢。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes18
: Hello?
lines.zh: 喂？

lines.en: : Hi. I have a bit of an issue.
lines.zh: 嗨。我有点麻烦。

lines.en: : You have many issues, Akira. Surely you don’t expect me to be able to help you with {i}all{/i} of them?
lines.zh: 你的麻烦可多了，Akira。你该不会指望我能帮你解决{i}全部{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Not all of them. This one would be nice, though.
lines.zh: 不用全部。不过这个能解决就好了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. But I told you last night that I don’t want to have sex with you yet. I don’t care how desperately you miss my body.
lines.zh: 抱歉。可我昨晚就跟你说了，我现在还不想跟你上床。不管你有多想念我的身体，我都不在乎。

lines.en: : That’s not it. I promise.
lines.zh: 不是那件事。我保证。

lines.en: : Well what is {i}it{/i} then? Because I’m very busy throwing away all the things in your room that I don’t like right now and you are bothering me.
lines.zh: 那{i}到底{/i}是什么事？因为我现在正忙着把你房间里我不喜欢的东西都扔掉，而你在烦我。

lines.en: : So, do you remember all those times I used to call you to prove to people that we’re dating?
lines.zh: 那么，你还记得以前我总打电话给你、好向别人证明我们在交往的那些时候吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Do you remember yesterday when I confirmed this to the entire world on social media, thus ensuring that such a thing would never have to happen again?
lines.zh: 记得。你还记得昨天我在社交媒体上向全世界确认了这件事、从而确保这种事再也不用发生了吗？

lines.en: : See, that’s exactly the problem. Your post sent one of my ex-students into shock and now she’s no longer moving or speaking and her sister is binging on sugar.
lines.zh: 瞧，问题就在这儿。你那条动态把我以前的一个学生吓休克了，现在她不动也不说话，她妹妹则在狂吃糖。

lines.en: : {i}You told me I could!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是你说我可以的！{/i}

lines.en: : I see. And {i}why{/i} do you know this, exactly?
lines.zh: 这样啊。那{i}为什么{/i}你会知道这些，具体说来？

lines.en: : Because I’m at her apartment as we speak.
lines.zh: 因为我现在就在她公寓里。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes19
: Oh, good. That’s an excellent thing to hear less than twenty-four hours after talking me back into a relationship with you.
lines.zh: 哦，好极了。在把我哄回这段关系还不到二十四小时之后，听到这个真是再好不过了。

lines.en: : You don’t get it. I’m only here because her little sister called me after failing to resolve things on her own.
lines.zh: 你不明白。我来这儿只是因为她妹妹自己搞不定，打电话叫我来。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearing is that your number is in some little girl’s phone and you also know where she lives.
lines.zh: 那我听到的就是：你的号码在某个小女孩的手机里，而且你还知道她住哪儿。

lines.en: : Can you help me or not? Because I can promise you you’d much prefer this option than the other one floating around right now.
lines.zh: 你到底帮不帮我？因为我可以保证，比起眼下另一个悬着的方案，你会更想要这个。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes20
: Ugh. What do I have to do? Just come there and fucking...{i}sign{/i} something? What do you want from me?
lines.zh: 呃。我要做什么？就过去他妈的……{i}签{/i}个什么东西？你到底想要我怎样？

lines.en: : I don’t think you need to sign anything. Just come...say hi or something. She’s one of your biggest fans, so I’m pretty sure your presence alone will shock her back into existence.
lines.zh: 我觉得你不用签什么。就过来……打个招呼什么的。她是你最大的粉丝之一，所以我敢肯定光是你出现就能把她震回现实。

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes21
: {i}Hah...{/i}fine. But only because I want to put her in her place and dissuade her from pursuing you any further than she already has, you pathetic, teen-fucking human dildo.
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}行吧。不过只是因为我想让她认清自己的位置，别再继续追着你不放，你这个可悲的、专睡高中生的活人阳具。

lines.en: : Thank you, Niki. I’ll try and wrestle the knife out of her hand in the meantime.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，Niki。趁这工夫我试着把她手里的刀夺下来。

lines.en: : Wonderful. Just send me the address and-
lines.zh: 好极了。把地址发给我就好——

lines.en: scene chinaminewclothes22
: Wait, why is there a knife in her hand?! Just what the fuck are you getting me into?!
lines.zh: 等等，她手里为什么会有一把刀？！你他妈到底把我卷进什么鬼事情里了？！
